description: This file is a shell script used for automating build, patching, testing, and coverage analysis tasks for the entservices-appgateway project. It manages repository checkouts, applies patches, configures builds with CMake, runs tests, and generates coverage reports, including handling dependencies like Thunder, ThunderTools, googletest, and entservices-apis.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints informational messages with a prefix.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Prints error messages to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the script is running as root.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if apt-get can be used (i.e., if the program has root or sudo privileges).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get commands non-interactively with the specified arguments.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs non-fatal failures, continuing execution.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to run git non-interactively.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref in a repository directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repo if necessary and checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has a CMake cache (configured).

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a component has been installed in a prefix path.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component via CMake, with optional extra arguments.
